note: Each platform's node tags and the identity circuits' buffers for it.
A node is SHA256(tag || value). A tag is 1 to 31 ASCII bytes, so
bearer-link takes it as one Field. Tags are distinct and prefix-free, so
no two platforms and no id and handle share a node.
maxHandle and maxId are buffer sizes in bytes: a longer value is refused,
never truncated. idShape `decimal` is an id of digits 0-9, `string` an id
Changing a value changes what a deployed verifier accepts.
The handle is the `email` claim as sent: dots, +tag and domain are kept.

platforms.note: The id is a JSON string of digits. maxHandle, maxId and idShape equal GitHub's: bearer-link has one set of buffers.
The handle is the login, at most 39 bytes. The id is a JSON number of digits.
